insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 37% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 20% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +9% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (155) vs Lululemon (177). Gap of 22 to close.
Leggings opportunity: Lululemon has 207 vs Vuori's 174. Gap of 33 SKUs.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 45% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1454 vs 1223 products. A 19% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 676 products. Behind Gymshark (1304).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 515 products vs Lululemon's 648. Key for cooler weather expansion.
